name: awm-integration
description: Integrates the discovery system with the AWM smart contracts for payments and escrow

steps.description: Set up virtual environment and install required packages

components.name: awm_integration.py
components.purpose: Handles interaction with the deployed AWM contract for payments and escrow
key_features: Connects to AWM contract using verified ABI
Provides methods for creating/funding work requests
Methods for claiming, submitting, and releasing payment for work

integration_points.description: When work is completed in discovery system, call awm_integration to release payment via smart contract

next_steps: Update discovery_system.py to call awm_integration when work is completed
Test the integration with real transactions using test ETH
Create agent clients that use both systems
Deploy as a service for continuous operation
